stem.en: On Monday ABC Bakery threw away 30 unsold loaves. On Tuesday it had no bread left by ten in the morning. Which job of operations would help on both days?

explanation.en: Operations plans daily production so that fresh bread is ready without delay or waste. Better planning means fewer loaves thrown away and fewer empty shelves.

hints.en: Too much bread one day and too little the next: what was not planned well?

text.en: Posting more photos of the bread on social media
Planning how much bread to bake each day
Hiring a cashier for the front counter
Taking a bigger loan from the bank
